# SemRels Organization Profile & Governance (`.github`)

This repository contains the organization-wide GitHub profile ([`profile/README.md`](profile/README.md)), default community health files, and Renovate presets for the [**SemRels**](https://github.com/SemRels) organization — creators of [**semrel**](https://www.semrel.io), the zero-dependency, Go-native semantic release automation tool and open-source alternative to `semantic-release`, `GoReleaser`, and `release-please`.

- **Documentation & Website:** [https://www.semrel.io](https://www.semrel.io)
- **Core Repository:** [https://github.com/SemRels/semrel](https://github.com/SemRels/semrel)
- **Plugin Registry:** [https://registry.semrel.io](https://registry.semrel.io)
- **Official Plugins Catalog:** [https://github.com/SemRels/semrel-plugins](https://github.com/SemRels/semrel-plugins)
